items.title: AMETEK’s (NYSE:AME) Q2 CY2026: Strong Sales
items.summary: Electronic products manufacturer AMETEK (NYSE:AME) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 15% year on year to $2.04 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.09 per share was 4.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
